verses.text: Now faith na di assurance of things wey we hope for, di proof of things wey we no see.
Because through dis faith di elders get good testimony.
By faith we understand say God word create di universe, so that wetin we dey see no come from things wey dey visible.
By faith Abel offer better sacrifice to God pass Cain, and through am dem testify say e righteous, as God testify about im gifts; and through faith, even though e don die, e still dey talk.
By faith dem carry Enoch go, so that e no go see death, “and dem no find am, because God carry am go.” Because before dem carry am go, dem don testify say e please God well.
Without faith e no possible to please am, because anybody wey come to God must believe say e dey, and say e dey reward dem wey dey look for am.
By faith Noah, as God warn am about things wey never dey seen, fear God and build ark to save im house, and through am e condemn di world, and e become heir of di righteousness wey dey by faith.
By faith Abraham, when God call am, obey and go to di place wey e go receive as inheritance. E go, as e no know wia e dey go.
By faith e live as stranger for di land of promise, like land wey no be im own, as e dey stay inside tents with Isaac and Jacob, wey be heirs with am of di same promise:
because e dey wait for di city wey get foundations, wey God be di builder and maker.
By faith Sarah imself receive power to become pregnant, and e born pikin even when e don pass di age, because e count di one wey promise as faithful.
So from one man, wey don almost die, plenty people born, plenty like di stars for heaven and like sand for di seaside wey nobody fit count.
All dese people die for faith, as dem no receive di promises, but dem see dem from far and welcome dem, and dem confess say dem na strangers and travelers for earth.
Because dem wey dey talk like dis dey show clear say dem dey look for country of dem own.
If dem dey think about di country wey dem comot from, dem for get chance to go back.
But now dem want better country, dat na heavenly one. So God no shame say dem call am dem God, because e don prepare city for dem.
By faith Abraham, when dem test am, offer Isaac. Yes, di one wey gladly receive di promises dey ready to offer im only pikin,
wey dem talk about am say, “Na through Isaac dem go count your descendants,”
as e believe say God fit raise people even from di dead. Na so, like say na from di dead, e receive am back.
By faith Isaac bless Jacob and Esau about things wey dey come.
By faith Jacob, when e dey die, bless each of Joseph sons, and e worship as e dey lean on di top of im staff.
By faith Joseph, when im end near, talk about how Israel pikin dem go comot, and e give command about im bones.
By faith dem hide Moses for three months when dem born am, by im papa and mama, because dem see say e be fine pikin, and dem no fear di king command.
By faith Moses, when e don grow, refuse make dem call am di son of Pharaoh daughter,
as e choose to suffer with God people instead of to enjoy di pleasure of sin for small time;
as e count di shame of Christ as bigger riches pass di treasures of Egypt, because e dey look di reward.
By faith e leave Egypt, no fear di king anger, because e endure as person wey dey see di one wey nobody fit see.
By faith e keep di Passover and di sprinkling of blood, so that di destroyer of di firstborn no go touch dem.
By faith dem pass through di Red Sea like dry land. When di Egyptians try do di same, di sea swallow dem.
By faith di walls of Jericho fall down, after dem don go round dem for seven days.
By faith Rahab di prostitute no perish with dem wey disobey, because e receive di spies for peace.
Wetin more I go talk? Because time no go reach me if I tell about Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel and di prophets;
dem wey through faith win kingdoms, do righteousness, receive promises, close di mouth of lions,
put out di power of fire, escape di edge of sword, from weakness dem become strong, dem become mighty for war, and make foreign armies run.
Women receive dem dead back through resurrection. Others dem torture, as dem no accept dem freedom, so that dem go get better resurrection.
Others face mocking and whipping, yes, even chain and prison.
Dem stone dem. Dem cut dem for two with saw. Dem tempt dem. Dem kill dem with sword. Dem go about inside sheepskin and goatskin, as dem poor, dem suffer and dem treat dem bad,
di world no worthy of dem. Dem dey wander for deserts, mountains, caves and holes for di ground.
All dese people, even though dem get good testimony through dem faith, no receive di promise,
because God don prepare better thing for us, so that dem no go reach perfection without us.
So since plenty witnesses dey surround us like cloud, make we put down every load and di sin wey dey tangle us easily, and make we run with patience di race wey dem put before us,
as we dey look Jesus, di author and perfecter of faith, wey endure di cross for di joy wey dey before am, e no mind di shame, and now e don sit for di right hand of God throne.
Because think about di one wey endure so much opposition from sinners against imself, so that una no go tire and lose heart.
Una never fight reach blood as una dey struggle against sin;
and una don forget di encouragement wey dey talk to una like pikin dem, “My pikin, no take di Lord discipline small, and no lose heart when e rebuke you;
“because di Lord dey discipline di one wey e love, and e dey punish every pikin wey e receive.”
Na for discipline una dey endure. God dey treat una like pikin dem, because which pikin dey wey im papa no dey discipline?
But if una no get discipline, wey all of dem don share, den una no be real pikin dem, but pikin wey no get papa claim.
Again, we get our papa dem for flesh wey dey discipline us, and we dey respect dem. We no suppose submit even more to di Papa of spirits, so that we go live?
Because dem dey punish us for few days as e good for dem eye; but God dey do am for our profit, so that we go share for im holiness.
For di present time every discipline no dey look like joy but like pain; but after dat e dey give di peaceful fruit of righteousness to dem wey e don train.
So lift up di hands wey don hang down and di knees wey weak,
and make straight path for una feet, so that wetin dey lame no go comot from joint, but e go heal.
Follow peace with all men, and di holiness wey without am nobody go see Lord,
as una dey watch well, so that nobody go miss God grace; so that no root of bitterness go grow and trouble una, and plenty people go dirty because of am;
so that nobody go be sexually immoral person or person wey no respect holy things, like Esau, wey sell im birthright for one meal.
Because una know say even when e later want inherit di blessing, dem reject am, because e no find chance to change im mind, even though e look for am well well with tears.
Because una no come to mountain wey person fit touch, wey dey burn with fire, and to blackness, darkness and storm,
di sound of trumpet and di voice of words; wey dem wey hear am beg say make dem no talk even one more word to dem,
because dem no fit bear wetin dem command: “If even animal touch di mountain, dem go stone am”;
and di sight so fearful so tay Moses talk say, “Fear full me and I dey shake.”
But una don come to Mount Zion, and to di city of di God wey dey alive, di heavenly Jerusalem, and to plenty plenty angels wey nobody fit count,
to di general gathering and church of di firstborn wey dem write dem name for heaven, to God di Judge of all, to di spirits of righteous men wey dem don make perfect,
to Jesus, di mediator of new covenant, and to di blood wey dem sprinkle wey dey talk better pass Abel own.

Make una see say una no refuse di one wey dey talk. Because if dem no escape when dem refuse di one wey warn dem for earth, how much more we no go escape if we turn comot from di one wey dey warn from heaven,
wey im voice shake di earth before, but now e don promise say, “One more time I go shake no be only di earth, but di heavens too.”
Dis word, “One more time,” show say dem go remove di things wey dem shake, as things wey dem make, so that di things wey no dey shake go remain.
So as we dey receive Kingdom wey no fit shake, make we get grace, wey we go use serve God for way wey go please am with respect and fear,
because our God na fire wey dey consume.
Make love for brothers continue.
No forget to welcome strangers, because by dat some people don welcome angels without say dem know.
Remember dem wey dey for chain, like say una dey chain with dem, and dem wey dem dey treat bad, because una too dey inside body.
Make everybody honor marriage, and make di marriage bed clean; because God go judge di sexually immoral and adulterers.
Make una no love money, make una dey satisfied with wetin una get; because e don talk say, “I no go ever leave you, and I no go ever forsake you.”
So we fit talk with courage say, “Di Lord na my helper. I no go fear. Wetin man fit do me?”
Remember una leaders, dem wey talk God word to una, and as una dey look how dem life end, make una follow dem faith.
Jesus Christ na di same yesterday, today and forever.
No make different and strange teachings carry una go, because e good make grace make di heart strong, no be food, wey no benefit dem wey dey follow am.
We get altar wey dem wey dey serve for di tabernacle no get right to chop from.
Because dem dey burn di bodies of dose animals wey di high priest dey carry dem blood enter di holy place for sin, outside di camp.
So Jesus too, so that e go make di people holy through im own blood, suffer outside di gate.
So make we go meet am outside di camp, as we dey carry im shame.
Because we no get city wey go last here, but we dey look for di one wey dey come.
So through am make we dey offer sacrifice of praise to God all di time, dat na di fruit of lips wey dey declare im name.
But no forget to dey do good and share, because God dey please with dis kind sacrifices.
Obey una leaders and submit to dem, because dem dey watch over una souls, as people wey go give account, so that dem go do am with joy and no with groaning, because dat one no go profit una.
Pray for us, because we sure say we get good conscience, as we want live well for everything.
I beg una strongly make una do dis one, so that God go return me to una quick.
Now make di God of peace, wey bring our Lord Jesus back from di dead, di great Shepherd of di sheep, with di blood of covenant wey no dey end,
make una complete for every good work to do im will, as e dey work inside us wetin dey please am, through Jesus Christ; make glory dey for am forever and ever. Amen.
But I urge una, brothers, make una bear dis word of encouragement, because I don write to una with few words.
Know say our brother Timothy don free, and if e come soon, I go see una with am.
Greet all una leaders and all di holy people. Dem wey come from Italy dey greet una.
Grace dey with una all. Amen.
